title: Frozen website rejects the native current assessment contract
expected: The website snapshot named by the candidate must consume current native assessment results for its supported review-bearing cycles.
observed: Native review/lanes.rs3 selects codefriend.review_lane.v4; runner539-547 emits it. Website validateAssessmentReview only admits all lane_versions == codefriend.review_lane.v2 and independently requires v2 on each lane. Runs.recordResult invokes cycle validation, which invokes this validator.
trigger: A review-bearing cycle completes using the current native assessment producer and the frozen website consumer.
impact: The successfully computed review cannot be accepted or continued through the website; hosted assessment cycles fail with result_identity_mismatch/assessment_review_invalid. Local cycle verification shares the same incompatible consumer. No live deployment failure is asserted.
recommendation: Update website versioned validator/prompt-digest/gap handling to native supported generations, preserve historical v2 identities, and bind native-emitted v4 complete/partial/invalid records in a cross-repository interop test.
proof: Actual website validator accepts its legacy fixture and rejects the same resealed record declaring native current v4; current producer and consumer callpaths independently source-confirmed.
limitations: Version-gate fixture is not a complete native v4 emission. No paid/live run. Source mismatch is deterministic regardless of later v4 prompt/digest checks.
route: #921 with CodeFriend website/native integration owner; coordinate frozen source pair before #918 refresh
